thesis: The page is one canyon-rim deck drawn in section: under every band the same slope line gets the next part of the deck built on it (footings, posts, joists, boards, rail, lamps), so the deck is finished at the hour its lights come on.

signature.name: Slope Section Build
signature.summary: One SVG grade line of a canyon slope with hatched earth beneath and a deck assembly at the rim; parts (footing, post, beam, joist, board, rail, lamp) appear cumulatively via --built and draw in via --sw-p, tagged with an evening hour in mono. Hero shows the bare slope, the pinned story builds it part by part 4 PM to 9 PM, service cards crop their part, the fence estimator steps panels down the grade, review cards carry a rail slice, footer shows the finished deck with every lamp lit.

palette.family: Marine Layer Navy + Deck Lamp Amber + Chaparral Sage

layoutMoves: pinned slope-section story with hour rail on the left, copy right (stacked cards under 900px)
services as a long drawn elevation strip: cards hang along one continuous grade line, deck parts uphill, fence parts downhill
proof as a rail: review cards set between posts of a drawn cable rail, rating as lit lamps
footer as the 10 PM night plate: finished deck silhouette with areas as spot elevations along the grade

motion.intro: h1 line-mask rise (70ms stagger, 700ms) while the strip (drawing + duotone photo) warms from blue-grey to amber and two footing marks drop onto the grade line; readable from frame 0, total 1.1s.
stories: build: pinned slope section draws one deck part per step via --sw-p, hour tag advances 4 PM to 9 PM, band darkens mid to deep
draw: fence estimator redraws posts every 8 ft and stepped panels along the grade as inputs change
motion.hover: 1.5px amber grade-line underline drawing left to right (scaleX 200ms)
